constraints.name: artifacts_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> 'complete'::text) OR ((sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND ((media_kind <> 'image'::text) OR (decoded_pixels IS NOT NULL)))))

constraints.name: decision_candidates_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((eligible AND (exclusion_reason IS NULL)) OR ((NOT eligible) AND (exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(exclusion_reason)) > 0))))

constraints.name: decision_candidates_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((predicted_cost IS NULL) OR (cost_model_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: experiment_conditions_scenario_input_volume_arrival_pattern_key
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (scenario, input_volume, arrival_pattern, mode, dataset_split, fixture_key, protocol_version)

constraints.name: run_measurements_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((modeled_cost IS NULL) OR (cost_model_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: run_measurements_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((allocated_idle_cost IS NULL) OR ((observation_window_start IS NOT NULL) AND (cost_model_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: run_measurements_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((end_to_end_ms IS NOT NULL) AND (modeled_cost IS NOT NULL)) OR ((unavailable_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(unavailable_reason)) > 0))))

constraints.name: selected_candidate_same_decision
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id, selected_candidate_id) REFERENCES app.decision_candidates(decision_id, id)

constraints.name: selection_decisions_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT is_fallback) OR (selected_candidate_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: task_attempts_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((finished_at IS NULL) OR (finished_at >= COALESCE(started_at, queued_at))))

constraints.name: task_attempts_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['running'::text, 'succeeded'::text])) OR (started_at IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: task_measurements_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((modeled_cost IS NULL) OR (cost_model_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: task_measurements_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((processing_ms IS NOT NULL) AND (modeled_cost IS NOT NULL) AND (actual_cpu_seconds IS NOT NULL) AND (peak_memory_bytes IS NOT NULL)) OR ((unavailable_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(unavailable_reason)) > 0))))

constraints.name: workflow_edges_version_id_source_node_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (version_id, source_node_id) REFERENCES app.workflow_nodes(version_id, id)

constraints.name: workflow_edges_version_id_target_node_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (version_id, target_node_id) REFERENCES app.workflow_nodes(version_id, id)

constraints.name: workflow_runs_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((finished_at IS NULL) OR (finished_at >= COALESCE(started_at, accepted_at))))

constraints.name: workflow_runs_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['running'::text, 'succeeded'::text])) OR (started_at IS NOT NULL)))
